integrity.new_step: Exact matrix evaluation of the four diagonal pairings for both distinguished collections; the terminating nilpotent binomial expansion proves the formulas for all nonnegative degrees.
integrity.source_inputs: The source supplies the definition of M72, its standard and right-dual Euler matrices, the action T_*=-A^{-t}A, geometric-helix vanishing, and the general binomial formula for Hilbert functions.

scientific_limitations: The result classifies the anticanonical Hilbert functions only for the standard collection and its right dual, not for every exceptional object in the mutation orbit.
The Hom-dimension interpretation uses geometricity of the relevant helices.
The calculation determines Hilbert functions and series, not the graded-algebra isomorphism types for the middle right-dual objects.
title: The \(M_{72}\) minifold has two anticanonical Hilbert functions in its right-dual collection
